project.description: This configures PIC-SURE for the DB, but also configures the DB for PIC-SURE.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MYSQL_HOST_NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The server name on which MySQL is running

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MYSQL_USER_NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The root username for the MySQL Database. The user should privileges to create users in the system.

hudson.model.PasswordParameterDefinition.name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
hudson.model.PasswordParameterDefinition.description: The root user password for the MySQL Database

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MYSQL_PORT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: MySQL server is listening on, used by MySQL client, MySQL Connectors

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash echo "Configure Remote MySql Instance" FILE="/root/.my.cnf" cat <<EOM >$FILE [mysql] user=$MYSQL_USER_NAME password="$MYSQL_PASSWORD" host=$MYSQL_HOST_NAME port=$MYSQL_PORT EOM echo ""
flyway_auth_url=jdbc:mysql://$MYSQL_HOST_NAME:$MYSQL_PORT/auth?serverTimezone=UTC flyway_picsure_url=jdbc:mysql://$MYSQL_HOST_NAME:$MYSQL_PORT/picsure?serverTimezone=UTC
cd /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/auth sed -i '/flyway.url/d' ./flyway-auth.conf sed -i "1iflyway.url=$flyway_auth_url" ./flyway-auth.conf sed -i '/host/d' ./sql.properties sed -i "1ihost=$MYSQL_HOST_NAME" ./sql.properties sed -i '/port/d' ./sql.properties sed -i "2iport=$MYSQL_PORT" ./sql.properties
cd /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/picsure sed -i '/flyway.url/d' ./flyway-picsure.conf sed -i "1iflyway.url=$flyway_picsure_url" ./flyway-picsure.conf sed -i '/host/d' ./sql.properties sed -i "1ihost=$MYSQL_HOST_NAME" ./sql.properties sed -i '/port/d' ./sql.properties sed -i "2iport=$MYSQL_PORT" ./sql.properties
sed -i 's/jdbc:mysql*.*auth/jdbc:mysql:\/\/'$MYSQL_HOST_NAME':'$MYSQL_PORT'\/auth/g' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env
# picsure DB owner is now the operations-service; point it at the remote instance too. OPS_ENV=/usr/local/docker-config/operations/operations.env PICSURE_PASSWORD=""
# Creating this file (or its directory) would switch INCLUDE_OPERATIONS on in # start-picsure.sh and deploy operations-service with no internal tokens. if [ ! -f "$OPS_ENV" ]; then echo "operations.env is not present; skipping operations-service wiring." echo "Run 'Migrate PIC-SURE Environment' or the Initial Configuration Pipeline first, then rerun this job." else PICSURE_PASSWORD=$(grep '^SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=' "$OPS_ENV" | cut -d '=' -f 2-) if [ -z "$PICSURE_PASSWORD" ] || [ "$PICSURE_PASSWORD" = "__PICSURE_MYSQL_PASSWORD__" ]; then PICSURE_PASSWORD=$(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' < /dev/urandom | head -c 24) if grep -q '^SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=' "$OPS_ENV"; then sed -i "s|^SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=.*|SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=$PICSURE_PASSWORD|" "$OPS_ENV" else echo "SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=$PICSURE_PASSWORD" >> "$OPS_ENV" fi fi
if grep -q '^SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=' "$OPS_ENV"; then sed -i 's|^SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=.*|SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:mysql://'$MYSQL_HOST_NAME':'$MYSQL_PORT'/picsure?useUnicode=true\&characterEncoding=UTF-8\&autoReconnect=true\&autoReconnectForPools=true\&serverTimezone=UTC|' "$OPS_ENV" else echo 'SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:mysql://'$MYSQL_HOST_NAME':'$MYSQL_PORT'/picsure?useUnicode=true&characterEncoding=UTF-8&autoReconnect=true&autoReconnectForPools=true&serverTimezone=UTC' >> "$OPS_ENV" fi fi
AIRFLOW_PASSWORD=`grep "password" /usr/local/docker-config/flyway/auth/sql.properties | cut -d "=" -f2-` AUTH_PASSWORD=`grep '^DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=' /usr/local/docker-config/psama/psama.env | cut -d '=' -f 2-`
docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "grant all privileges on auth.* to 'airflow'@'%' identified by '$AIRFLOW_PASSWORD';flush privileges;" mysql docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "grant all privileges on picsure.* to 'airflow'@'%' identified by '$AIRFLOW_PASSWORD';flush privileges;" mysql if [ -n "$PICSURE_PASSWORD" ]; then docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "grant all privileges on picsure.* to 'picsure'@'%' identified by '$PICSURE_PASSWORD';flush privileges;" mysql else echo "No operations-service password configured; leaving the picsure MySQL user untouched." fi docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "grant all privileges on auth.* to 'auth'@'%' identified by '$AUTH_PASSWORD';flush privileges;" mysql
if [ "$DROP_EXISTING_TABLES" = "TRUE" ]; then docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "drop database IF EXISTS auth;" mysql docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "drop database IF EXISTS picsure;" mysql fi
docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "create database IF NOT EXISTS auth;" mysql docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf mysql mysql -e "create database IF NOT EXISTS picsure;" mysql
